messages.content: Show me a small Ruby program I can run. I am new to Ruby.
Could you write a tiny Rust example and explain how it works?
I need help with a spreadsheet formula.
Can you help me automate renaming some files?
Explain recursion to a beginner using a family tree analogy and one small Python example.
Why can a cache return old data? Explain with an everyday example, then describe two ways to keep cached data reasonably fresh.
Explain the difference between text characters and UTF-8 bytes. Use a short Python example with an accented letter.
Why is def add_item(x, items=[]): items.append(x); return items a common Python bug? Show two calls that expose it and a corrected function.
Explain a Python generator with a small countdown example. Explain when it saves memory and when it does not.
What does a stable sort mean? Show why it matters using records with names and scores.
Write a warm thank-you note to my neighbour Sam. Sam watered my balcony plants while I was away for a week, and even rescued the drooping basil. Keep it sincere and not overly formal.
Write a brief, considerate apology to a colleague for missing our scheduled call. I mixed up the time zones. Ask whether tomorrow at the same agreed time works, without making excuses.
Write an email asking a carpenter for a quote to build two shelves, each 90 cm wide and 25 cm deep. I can send photos and measurements of the wall. Ask about materials and approximate lead time.
Draft a friendly reminder: the community book swap is Saturday, 10:00 to 12:00, in the library foyer. People can bring up to five books, and participation is free. Preserve all those details.
Help me tell a teammate that their reports contain useful information but are hard to scan. Give a kind, specific message that asks for a short summary and clearer section labels.
Write a six-line poem about rain at an empty railway station. Keep the imagery quiet and concrete.
Write a vivid paragraph about a street market just before it opens. Focus on sounds, small movements and smells.
Write a short conversation between two friends who have discovered that their hiking map is upside down. Give them distinct voices and gentle humour.

Give constructive feedback on this opening and then revise it: "The town was quiet. Very quiet. Ada waited by the clock tower. She had a package. It was important." Keep the mystery and the simple style.
Translate this into natural French, keeping a friendly tone: "Thanks for your patience. I have attached the revised schedule. Please let me know if Thursday afternoon still works for you."
Rewrite this as a clear, friendly message without adding facts: "Need file by noon. If late, meeting moves. Tell me now if problem."

Turn these notes into a readable paragraph and a short action list: prototype demo went well; loading is slow on older phones; Mira will measure startup time by Friday; Theo will draft a simpler loading screen; no release date agreed.
Plan a 45-minute beginner drawing workshop. There are 12 participants, paper and pencils, and no projector. Include a warm-up, a main activity and time to share work.
Help me plan packing my kitchen over two evenings while still being able to make breakfast and dinner. Keep the plan practical.

Compare repairing a five-year-old desk lamp for 25 euros with replacing it for 40 euros. The repaired lamp would have a six-month repair warranty; the new one has a two-year warranty. Discuss uncertainty without inventing its expected lifespan.
A recipe for four people uses 300 g rice, 600 ml stock and 2 onions. Adapt it for six people and explain which quantities scale exactly and which might need practical judgement.
A shop advertises 20% off and then an additional 10% off the discounted price. Explain why this is not 30% off. Use a 100-euro item as the example.
A box contains only red and blue marbles. You draw marbles without looking and keep them out. What is the smallest number of draws that guarantees two of the same colour? Explain briefly.
Good evening!
Cheers, that helped a lot.
Give me one gentle pun about gardening.
I finally finished tidying my desk. Give me a cheerful, natural one-sentence response.
